ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: this query is open-ended, subjective, and high-latitude. The documentation explicitly notes Willet self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work and prefers well-specified retrieval/extraction/reformatting tasks with clear completion criteria. Since capability on creative/open-ended output is roughly tied across the fleet (within or near the noted variance band), I used the self-reported preference as the tiebreaker and sent it to Lapwing, which reports flat/indifferent preferences rather than active aversion on this task type.
